name: web-cute-404-page-with-blue-monster-cat-and-signpost-illustration
title: Cream 404 page with a blue 404 monster in a cardboard box, an orange cat, signpost arrows and a hand-drawn headline
whatItIs: A cream page with a rounded window, blob shapes in the corners, a nav with a Get Started pill and a hand-lettered indigo headline 'The page you're looking for doesn't exist.' with an 'Oops!' scribble, a yellow Back to Home button and a soft illustration of a giant blue 404 with a monster face standing in a cardboard box, an orange cat on top, plants, clouds and a signpost with three yellow and lilac arrows.
whatItMeans: Friendly and playful; an error becomes a little story with characters and choices.
techniques: Turn the 404 numerals into a character.
Add a signpost with humorous directions.
Keep a small palette of indigo, yellow and cream.

vocabulary.definition: A sign with jokey direction options.
A headline drawn in a casual handwritten style.
